title: VFX style profile (vfx-style) spec
description: The spec body of a vfx-style artifact: one per project, binding (binding_values true), stored under the authoring repo's vfx/style/. It fixes the look and the limits every effect of the project is graded against by scripts/vfx/vfx_style.py lint: palette and colour ramps per element, HDR intensity bands per importance tier, phase timing ratios, texture conventions, allowed outputs, blend modes and shaders, per-platform budgets, the capture viewing conditions and the asset-gen style the effect textures are generated with. Field values are compared with the com.cuvara.vfx recipe (cuvara.vfx-recipe/1), inspect output (cuvara.vfx-inspect/1) and capture statistics (cuvara.vfx-capture/1, mirror: docs/schemas/vfx-capture.schema.json).

purpose.description: what the profile is for: the game, its art direction and the effects it covers

assetgen_style.description: asset-gen style id the effect textures are generated with (templates/assetgen/styles/<id>.json or a game-layer style, for example realistic-pbr)

vfx_graph.description: VFX Graph major.minor the project's effects target; compared with the recipe's vfx_graph and the capture's vfx_graph

palette.description: named colours and ramps per element (fire, frost, lightning, ...); an effect names its element in the recipe meta.tags as element:<name>

hue_tolerance_degrees.description: largest hue distance in degrees between a colour of the effect and the nearest palette colour of its element

hdr_intensity.description: HDR intensity band per importance tier, in the units of Unity's HDR colour picker (log2 of the largest channel, the intensity field of the inspect hdr_colors); an effect names its tier in the recipe meta.tags as tier:<name> or in its vfx-spec

timing.description: share of the effect's duration (recipe meta.duration_seconds) each phase of the recipe meta.phases may take, matched by phase name

sum_tolerance_seconds.description: largest difference between the sum of the phase seconds and meta.duration_seconds

textures.description: conventions for the textures an effect references (the inspect textures and the import-texture transform)

max_size.description: largest width or height in pixels of an imported effect texture

channel_packing.description: named channel layouts of packed data textures (layout id to the content of each channel)

color_space.description: colour space of colour textures (the import-texture srgb or linear step; inspect srgb)

linear_textures.description: glob patterns of project texture paths that hold data and must be linear whatever color_space says (masks, noise, flow maps)

outputs.description: what an output context of an effect may be (the inspect outputs)

shaders.description: glob patterns an output's shader name or Shader Graph path must match (Hidden/VFX/* for the shaders VFX Graph generates)

budgets.description: budget per target platform id (android, webgl, windows, linux); an effect must fit every platform listed

capture.description: viewing conditions the evidence capture must use; names and values are those of the capture statistics (cuvara.vfx-capture/1)

notes.description: free-text guidance for authors and reviewers that the lint does not grade

colors.description: colour name to #RRGGBB (sRGB, LDR; HDR is graded by hdr_intensity)

ramp.description: colour names of this element in over-life order (birth to death)

max_alive_particles.description: largest alive count (capture alive.peak) and largest sum of system capacities

max_systems.description: largest number of particle systems in the effect

max_texture_memory_bytes.description: largest sum of the estimated GPU bytes of the effect's textures (inspect totals.texture_bytes)
